description: Makes one standalone Markdown (.md) file with YAML front matter. Use when the user wants notes, documentation or an article as a file. Needs content; title, frontmatter and filename are optional. Returns the full file text with a suggested file name, word count, line count and size in bytes. Nothing is stored. Use create_obsidian_note instead when the user wants the note opened in Obsidian.

content.description: Markdown document text (at most 100,000 characters), such as "## What went well\n- Shipped on time".

filename.description: Optional .md filename (defaults to sanitized title or document.md).

frontmatter.description: Optional extra YAML front matter as key-value pairs. Values can be text, numbers, true or false, or lists, such as {"status": "draft", "version": 1}.

title.description: Optional document title (included in YAML frontmatter).

name: create_markdown_file

filename.description: Sanitized filename for saving as a .md file.

line_count.description: Total line count of the document.

markdown_text.description: Complete formatted Markdown document with frontmatter.

notes.description: Short notes to pass on to the user.

status.description: Always ok when the file was made. Bad input returns an error instead.

word_count.description: Total word count of the document.

title: Create Markdown document
